steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Ethnic inequality in employment: ethnic minorities earn less on average. Wood's CV study: identical CVs, 'White' names got 74% more callbacks. This proves discrimination operates in hiring. | Key Fact: Institutional racism (Macpherson Report, 1999): 'the collective failure of an organisation to provide an appropriate service to people because of their colour, culture or ethnic origin'. Found the Met Police was institutionally racist. | Key Fact: Ethnicity and crime: Black people are 9x more likely to be stopped and searched; 12% of prison vs 3% of population. Self-report studies show similar offending rates - the disparity reflects policing bias. | Key Fact: Islamophobia: prejudice against Muslims increased after 9/11 and 7/7.
